tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250zab bdun tshe dkar sman mchod ni/1$0000300 chos sku kun bzang longs sku tshe dpag med// rdo rje sems dpa' 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*// dbang gi lha mo in+d+ra bhū ti la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// dga' rab rdo rje shrī siṃ ha dang*// nā gārdzu na hūm̐ mdzad bi ma la// tshe mchog grub pa'i rig 'dzin rgya mtsho la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// mtsho skyes rdo rje lha lcam man+dā ra// ye shes mtsho rgyal mnga' bdag yab sras dang*// lo chen bai ro gnyags chen dzñā na la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// dpal gyi dbang phyug lang gro dkon mchog 'byung*// bdud 'joms rdo rje mchog gyur bde chen gling*// chos bdag skyes mchog brgyud par bcas rnams la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// tshe bdag rigs lnga pho nya mgyogs ma bzhi// ḍā ki dam can drang srong rig pa 'dzin// gter bdag zhing skyong snang srid ka dag la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol//

dngos grub blang ba ni/ gnas gsum du thig le byas la/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi pha la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lcer myang la/ badz+ra a mṛta swa daṃ ku ru ṣā me/ zhes pa'ang nyer mkho'i dbang gis brag dmar g.ya' ma lung 'chi med tshe'i ke'u tshang du gu ṇas so// //
